legal.privacy_p1: This dealership website stores the information you send through vehicle inquiry forms: your name and the email or phone number you provide, plus any message. That data is kept so the business can answer you.
legal.privacy_p2: We also store a language cookie and a cookie-consent cookie on your device. Session data is used so staff can sign in to the dashboard. Appearance (light or dark) is saved in your browser, not on our servers.
legal.privacy_p3: We do not sell your contact details. Inquiries are visible only to the dealership operators in the private dashboard. You can ask for access, correction, or deletion by emailing the address listed on the Contact page.
legal.privacy_p4: This template is meant to be customized. Replace this text with the privacy notice of the actual dealership before going live, especially if you add analytics, ads, or payment tools.
legal.cookies_p1: We use a small set of cookies: locale (remembers English or Spanish), cookie_consent (remembers that you accepted this notice), and a session cookie for the staff dashboard.
legal.cookies_p2: These cookies are used to run the site, remember your language, and keep you signed in if you are staff. They are not used for advertising.
legal.cookies_p3: You can delete cookies in your browser settings. If you delete the consent cookie, this notice will appear again. If you delete the language cookie, the site returns to the default language.
legal.cookies_p4: If you later add third-party tools (maps, chat, analytics), list them here and update the consent banner before launch.
legal.terms_p1: Vehicle prices, descriptions, and availability come from the dealership database and may change. Listing a car is not an offer you can accept online; it is an invitation to contact the dealer.
legal.terms_p2: Photos and copy on this demo inventory are for illustration of the template. A live dealership is responsible for accurate listings and for any sale that follows.
legal.terms_p3: Do not misuse the inquiry form. Submit only genuine requests with a name and a way to reach you.
legal.terms_p4: The site is provided as a customer template. Replace these terms with a contract reviewed for the country where the dealership operates.
